methodology.test: Mann-Whitney U (two-sided, tie-corrected, normal approximation with continuity correction)
methodology.rationale: Impression counts are heavily right-skewed; rank-based tests are robust to that shape. Cliff's delta floor of 0.20 excludes tiny-but-significant differences that aren't practically actionable.

Cubs enter September holding a Wild Card spot.

Cardinals are 68-70 and fading. The NL field is thinning.

Seven games back of Milwaukee with 25 to play — the division won't close, but October is absolutely still on the table. Chicago holds its own fate.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB

Eduardo Rodriguez: 9 strikeouts in 7 innings. Boyd was solid — the offense just couldn't touch E-Rod.

Cubs drop the series finale 2-0. Went 1-2 in Arizona after Gausman's G1 gem.

Back to Wrigley. Reds come to town Friday.

#Cubs #GoCubs #CubsBaseball

NINE strikeouts. Seven innings. One run.

Gausman was FILTHY — 60% whiff rate with the splitter. Cubs took the series finale 2-1 and split with the NL-leading Brewers. Wild card spot: intact.

PCA's 2-run bomb (No. 39) did the heavy lifting.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

Rubber game. Chase Field. 2:40 PM CT.

Boyd (8-2, 4.15 ERA) vs E-Rod (10-4, 2.71 ERA).

Rodriguez has the edge on paper. Boyd's been tough when it matters — 8 wins for a reason.

Cubs took one. D-backs took one. Settle it this afternoon.

#Cubs #GoCubs #CubsBaseball

Chicago hit 62 home runs in August.

That's the most by any NL team in a single calendar month — ever. Only the 2019 Yankees (74) hit more in a month in MLB history.

This offense isn't just hot. It's historically elite.
